pages.text: $(bold)Tourists only walk on paved roads.$() Without roads there are no tourists — a shop can open but no one will enter.

Press $(bold)V$() to open the panel → the $(bold)Roads$() icon on the left. Pick a material in the bottom bar, and a tool in the mode bar. The cursor is always free — use it directly on the UI and in the world.
pages.title: Entering Road Mode

pages.text: $(bold)Mode  Usage  When to use it$()$(li)$(bold)Replace REPLACE$() — Hold left-click and drag a box, framing a rectangle — Everyday paving: turning grass and dirt into road surface$(li)$(bold)Fill FILL$() — Hold left-click and drag, pulling out a 3D box — Bridges, filling deep pits, laying foundations$(li)$(bold)Destroy DESTROY$() — Left-click to grab a reference block, then drag a box — Removing wrongly placed blocks, flattening terrain$(li)$(bold)Spline SPLINE$() — Opens the editor, click anchors in the world to draw curves — Curves, loops, interchanges
pages.title: The Four Modes

pages.text: Double-click a card in the bottom bar to pick: $(bold)Dirt Path / Road (Stone) / Grass / Water / Cobblestone / Gravel / Oak Planks$().
pages.title: Materials

pages.text: $(bold)Control  Action$()$(li)$(bold)Hold left-click + drag$() — Frame a selection: press to set the start, drag to expand, release to finish$(li)$(bold)Enter$() — Submit, publish the paving task$(li)$(bold)Backspace$() — Undo the last framing$(li)$(bold)ESC$() — Exit road construction$(br2)After submitting, wizard NPCs pave automatically according to the task (if materials are short, wait for NPCs to automatically synthesize the required building blocks); when enough buildings are placed, the town also plans roads automatically to connect them. For fine curves and interchanges, use the $(l:wandscape:road/road_spline_guide)Spline Editor$(/l).
